## Functions

### `ColorPicker`

```ts
ColorPicker(props: ColorPickerProps): Html
```

A colour picker: a swatch button that opens a panel with a
saturation/brightness square, a hue slider, an alpha slider when asked
for, a text field in the chosen `format`, the contrast ratio of the
colour against the page surface, and preset swatches. The form control
is a native `<input type="color">` with `name` — what a no-JS page
shows and posts — kept in step by color-picker.js (`change` fires on
it; `color-picker:change` with `{ hex, rgb, hsl, alpha, value }` fires on
the root). Square: drag or arrow keys (Shift: 10 steps). Escape closes
and returns focus to the trigger.

## Types

### `ColorFormat`

How the value is shown in the field and posted: `#rrggbb`, `rgb(r g b)`, `hsl(h s% l%)` (with `/ a` when `alpha`).

- `"hex"`
- `"rgb"`
- `"hsl"`

### `ColorPickerProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Required: the trigger carries it (the root when `inline`); the panel is `<id>-panel`, the native input `<id>-native`. |
| `name` | `string` |  |  |
| `value` | `string` |  | Any CSS colour the script can parse: `#rgb`, `#rrggbb[aa]`, `rgb()`, `hsl()`. @default "#3b82f6" |
| `format` | `ColorFormat` |  |  |
| `alpha` | `boolean` |  | An alpha slider. The posted value then carries the alpha (`#rrggbbaa`, `rgb(… / a)`); a no-JS page posts the native input's opaque colour. |
| `presets` | `string[]` |  | Swatches under the picker, any parseable colour each. |
| `inline` | `boolean` |  | Draw the panel in the flow, always open, with no trigger. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the trigger and the panel. @default "Colour" |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### A brand colour with presets

The native `<input type="color" name>` posts `#rrggbb`; a no-JS page shows it alone. `color-picker:change` on the root carries `{ hex, rgb, hsl, alpha, value }`.

```ts
FormField({
  id: "brand-native",
  label: "Brand colour",
  control: ColorPicker({
    id: "brand",
    name: "brand",
    value: "#3b82f6",
    presets: ["#3b82f6", "#10b981", "#f59e0b", "#ef4444", "#8b5cf6"],
  }),
})
```

```html
<div class="form-field">
  <label class="form-field__label" for="brand-native">Brand colour</label>
  <div class="color-picker" data-color-picker="" data-color="#3b82f6" data-format="hex">
    <input type="color" class="color-picker__native" id="brand-native" name="brand" value="#3b82f6" aria-label="Colour">
    <div class="color-picker__ui">
      <button type="button" class="color-picker__trigger" id="brand" data-color-picker-trigger="" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="brand-panel" aria-label="Colour">
        <span class="color-picker__swatch" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span class="color-picker__text" data-color-picker-text>#3b82f6</span>
      </button>
      <div class="color-picker__panel" id="brand-panel" role="dialog" aria-label="Colour" hidden="">
        <div class="color-picker__area" data-color-picker-area="" tabindex="0" role="slider" aria-label="Saturation and brightness" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="100">
          <span class="color-picker__thumb"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="color-picker__sliders">
          <label class="color-picker__slider">
            <span class="sr-only">Hue</span>
            <input type="range" class="color-picker__hue" data-color-picker-hue="" min="0" max="360" step="1" value="0" form="brand-search-scope" data-validate-skip="">
          </label>
        </div>
        <div class="color-picker__fields">
          <input type="text" class="input input--sm color-picker__field" data-color-picker-field="" value="#3b82f6" form="brand-search-scope" data-validate-skip="" aria-label="Colour value" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
          <span class="color-picker__contrast" data-color-picker-contrast title="Contrast against the page surface"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="color-picker__presets" role="group" aria-label="Presets">
          <button type="button" class="color-picker__preset" data-color-picker-preset="" data-color="#3b82f6" aria-label="#3b82f6" title="#3b82f6"></button>
          <button type="button" class="color-picker__preset" data-color-picker-preset="" data-color="#10b981" aria-label="#10b981" title="#10b981"></button>
          <button type="button" class="color-picker__preset" data-color-picker-preset="" data-color="#f59e0b" aria-label="#f59e0b" title="#f59e0b"></button>
          <button type="button" class="color-picker__preset" data-color-picker-preset="" data-color="#ef4444" aria-label="#ef4444" title="#ef4444"></button>
          <button type="button" class="color-picker__preset" data-color-picker-preset="" data-color="#8b5cf6" aria-label="#8b5cf6" title="#8b5cf6"></button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

### An overlay tint: alpha, posted as hsl()

With `alpha` or a non-hex `format` the script moves `name` to a hidden input holding the formatted value (`hsl(h s% l% / a)` here); without the script the native input posts the opaque colour.

```ts
ColorPicker({ id: "tint", name: "tint", value: "#0f172a80", alpha: true, format: "hsl" })
```

```html
<div class="color-picker" data-color-picker="" data-color="#0f172a80" data-format="hsl" data-alpha="">
  <input type="color" class="color-picker__native" id="tint-native" name="tint" aria-label="Colour">
  <div class="color-picker__ui">
    <button type="button" class="color-picker__trigger" id="tint" data-color-picker-trigger="" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="tint-panel" aria-label="Colour">
      <span class="color-picker__swatch" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <span class="color-picker__text" data-color-picker-text>#0f172a80</span>
    </button>
    <div class="color-picker__panel" id="tint-panel" role="dialog" aria-label="Colour" hidden="">
      <div class="color-picker__area" data-color-picker-area="" tabindex="0" role="slider" aria-label="Saturation and brightness" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="100">
        <span class="color-picker__thumb"></span>
      </div>
      <div class="color-picker__sliders">
        <label class="color-picker__slider">
          <span class="sr-only">Hue</span>
          <input type="range" class="color-picker__hue" data-color-picker-hue="" min="0" max="360" step="1" value="0" form="tint-search-scope" data-validate-skip="">
        </label>
        <label class="color-picker__slider">
          <span class="sr-only">Alpha</span>
          <input type="range" class="color-picker__alpha" data-color-picker-alpha="" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="100" form="tint-search-scope" data-validate-skip="">
        </label>
      </div>
      <div class="color-picker__fields">
        <input type="text" class="input input--sm color-picker__field" data-color-picker-field="" value="#0f172a80" form="tint-search-scope" data-validate-skip="" aria-label="Colour value" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
        <span class="color-picker__contrast" data-color-picker-contrast title="Contrast against the page surface"></span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Behaviour

`components/color-picker/color-picker.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-alpha`, `data-color`, `data-color-picker`, `data-color-picker-alpha`, `data-color-picker-area`, `data-color-picker-contrast`, `data-color-picker-disabled`, `data-color-picker-field`, `data-color-picker-hue`, `data-color-picker-preset`, `data-color-picker-text`, `data-color-picker-trigger`, `data-color-picker-value`, `data-format`, `data-pass`, `data-theme`.

Events: `rapid:swapped`.
